note: AC Milan 1-0 Celtic (aet), San Siro, 7 March 2007, Kaká's 93rd-minute winner. Chapter 1 is keyed from 'Celtic lose' (Sno loses the ball) through 'Kaká grabs', 'He pushes', 'brushes past', 'into the box' to 'goal' (the ball crossing the line): keep the pauses at '...' so the run plays near real time.

chapters.label: The run, live
chapters.text: Milan, 2007, extra time against Celtic on a wet night. Celtic lose the ball in midfield... Kaká grabs it and off he goes! He pushes it ahead, brushes past Neil Lennon, into the box... goal!

chapters.label: Watch it again
chapters.text: Watch it again, slowly. Big pushes send the ball into the space ahead, then he sprints after it. The defenders chase, but can’t catch him.

chapters.label: Under the keeper
chapters.text: He slides it underneath keeper Artur Boruc, and Milan are through!

chapters.label: Your turn
chapters.text: Your turn: when there’s space, push the ball ahead and sprint. Defenders can’t catch a fast run!
